result.topic_en: A draft of a faculty opinion (Gutachten) in which Riemann agrees with a proposal concerning a foundation for philosophical prize questions, discussing which branches of philosophy it should cover and whether all faculty members should take turns setting and judging the questions.

items.quote: Auch mir scheint die Annahme des Antrags im Interesse der Wissenschaft zu
items.english: To me too the acceptance of the proposal seems to be in the interest of science.
A restriction of the direction mainly to theory does not seem to me required by the provision excluding speculative philosophy.

items.quote:
so würde meiner Ansicht nach der Turnus auf [-...[?]-] {+sämmtliche+}
Mitglieder der Facultät ausgedehnt werden müssen
items.english: In my opinion the rotation would then have to be extended to all members of the faculty.
